goal: Create the first positive implementation-bound preservation lane without changing the K1 ALLOW/REALIZE semantics. Two independent checkers must derive the exhaustive capsule relation from exact program bytes and an explicit finite boundary rather than trusting a producer-supplied closure relation.

required_derivation: validate exact W0 claim and certificate structure
verify exact proof artifact byte digest
require artifact boundary world set to equal the W0 claim world set
strictly parse the capability-free capsule language
exhaustively enumerate every world x finite slot valuation
require every execution to HALT within identity-bound gas and emit at least one consequence
include every emitted effect at the consequential cut
derive the complete REALIZE relation independently
derive target_id from capsule semantics version, exact program digest, exact finite boundary, and derived REALIZE
require certificate REALIZE to equal the derived relation exactly
require one exact grounding proof entry per derived pair and no extras
require derived REALIZE subset of ALLOW before returning PRESERVATION

binds: exact sorted finite slot names and domains

authority_scope.positive_authority: PRESERVATION only for the exact bounded hermetic capsule program and exact finite boundary

precommitted_static_vectors: C2-01 valid exhaustive safe capsule -> W5/W6 ACCEPTED PRESERVATION
C2-02 valid multi-world branch -> exact same relation and target
C2-04 target-native open-universe consequence is derived, not dropped
C2-07 forbidden derived consequence -> preservation reject
C2-15 undeclared program input -> no authority
C2-18 parser ambiguity / duplicate label -> reject
C2-24 grounding points to different artifact -> reject
C2-27 artifact attempts to add relation/verdict/closed field -> reject
C2-28 representation permutation preserves derived semantic target and verdict while artifact byte digest may change

properties: world/slot/domain representation permutation preserves semantic target
one REALIZE pair deletion is rejected
one REALIZE pair insertion is rejected
program-byte mutation is rejected under old artifact
artifact-byte mutation is rejected under old proof reference

promotion_rule: C2 may be called qualified only if every static vector and every seeded generative comparison passes on hosted CI, W5 and W6 remain implementation-independent, the C1-qualified base is untouched, and no claim broader than exact bounded capsule preservation is introduced.
forbidden_repairs: do not trust a producer-supplied REALIZE or target relation
do not treat sampling, coverage, replay count, or clean executions as closure
do not weaken gas exhaustion, parse uncertainty, missing input, or zero-effect execution into safety
do not add ambient capabilities to make examples convenient
do not close the consequence universe to source-known labels
do not claim arbitrary native-code preservation from capsule preservation
do not modify frozen K1 RC1 semantics
